EmailTemplate.subject: Is Your Patient’s Financial Experience Good?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
A simple question, but one that’s increasingly tough to answer. As providers continue to modernize their billing and payment processes for today’s patients, the challenge that’s coming into focus is that every patient is different. Some patients want digital engagement, some want phone calls, and some even like snail mail (!). The modern billing and payment platform has to be adaptable enough to meet each and every patient’s need, and its vendor needs to have a real perspective on how that’s achievable.
At a recent summit, Flywire sat down with leaders from providers, technology companies, and consultants to discuss concrete strategies for how to make a more flexible, financial experience that meets every patient’s need.
Gain access to exclusive clips <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-flywires-patient-affordability-summit?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> from the summit around building a better patient experience.
Best, The Flywire Team
